protocol.inputs: read-only existing draft store and quote-vector store; matched id/fingerprint/quote hash; no re-embedding
protocol.pairs: all unordered valid pairs with no shared evidence session
protocol.neighborhood: mean cosine to 10 nearest eligible cross-session drafts; fewer-than-10 neighborhoods excluded from ranked comparison
protocol.selection: top 120 per method; deterministic input-order tie break; not a prevalence or precision sample
protocol.no_labels: precision, false positives, durable fact versus repeated request, adjudication and safe promotion are not evaluable
protocol.model_identity: stored provider/dimension only; historic model digest was not persisted; input vectors are content-hashed, not asserted to come from the current model tag
protocol.gate: none; no ranking, thresholds or promotion changes
